action_items.detail: JRN-155: BK-2627-3030 is booked on 19 Nov 2026, so As of 18 Nov it is not in Outstanding at all. The 'later waiver ignored' rule is only trivially true here. A waiver on an older booking, approved after the As-of date, is needed for a real test. As of today the booking shows waived ₹26,250 (WV-2627-0052 ₹25,000 plus earlier waivers).

The Cancellations link on the Feb 2026 Refunds line carries period_from=2000-01-01. Opening the Cancellations report with no period (default this FY) shows 0 rows, because both cancellations are dated FY25-26.

Preview writes: a tscheck ₹12,345 Account cheque was created and cleared on BK a4c0f93b…. A tscheck ₹20,000 manual bill plus ₹20,000 NEFT payment were posted on fully-paid booking 85b4bd88… (two manual bills now exist from the first and second runs). All of these are replaced by the nightly refresh. The seeded cheque KKT/2627/42976 was NOT cleared; the clearing journey used a cheque this test created.
Run the 3H backend files serially (-n 0). Under xdist, the manual-bill test's payment changes the Bank-wise total while the cheque test is reading it. This is a test-isolation issue, not an app bug.
